title: DALL·E in ChatGPT

body.text: Type a description of the image you want, and ChatGPT uses
DALL·E to create the image right in the chat
— and because it's a chat, you can ask for edits immediately, like changing colors, adding objects, or changing the camera angle.

example: "Create an image of an orange cat wearing sunglasses, working at a laptop in a coffee shop, pastel illustration style"

title: Write great image prompts

body.text: subject + action + scene + style + lighting/color tone
— the clearer you picture it, the more on-target the result, and specifying a style strongly controls the look.

example: "A minimalist bakery logo, a croissant, clean lines, golden-brown color, cream background"

question: What's the benefit of creating images through ChatGPT's chat?

options.text: You can ask for edits continuing from the same image

question: What should a good image prompt include?

options.text: Just a one-word object is enough
Subject, action, scene, style, and color tone

question: You got an image but want to change the background. What should you do?

options.text: Open a new chat and start over
Tell it in the same chat what background you want instead
It can't be done — you must use Photoshop

question: To get an illustration matching your imagination, how should you write the image prompt?

options.text: Clearly state the style, colors, composition, and viewpoint
